This guide covers installing MPAQT and all its dependencies. MPAQT has both R package dependencies and external system tools that must be installed separately.

## Prerequisites

**R Installation:**

Install R (>= 4.0.0) from [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/) with compilation tools (make, zlib, curl).

---

## Quick Install with pak (Recommended)

[pak](https://pak.r-lib.org/) is a modern R package manager that handles dependencies efficiently and supports installing from GitHub.

```r
# Install pak if not already installed
install.packages("pak")

# Install MPAQT from GitHub
pak::pak("csglab/MPAQT")
```

pak will automatically:

- Install all required R package dependencies from CRAN
- Prompt you to install Bioconductor packages if needed
- Handle version conflicts gracefully

## Alternative: devtools Installation

If you prefer using devtools:

```r
# Install devtools if needed
install.packages("devtools")

# Install MPAQT from GitHub
devtools::install_github("csglab/MPAQT")
```

## Installing from Local Source

If you have the package source code locally:

```r
# Using pak
pak::pak("local::/path/to/mpaqt")

# Or using devtools
devtools::install_local("/path/to/mpaqt")
```

---

## R Package Dependencies

### Required Packages (Automatically Installed)

These packages are installed automatically when you install MPAQT:

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `data.table` | Fast data manipulation |
| `Matrix` | Sparse matrix operations |
| `lme4` | Mixed-effects models |
| `gpboost` | Gradient boosting with random effects |
| `cli` | Terminal output formatting |
| `rlang` | Error handling and metaprogramming |
| `stringr` | String manipulation |
| `purrr` | Functional programming |
| `optparse` | Command-line argument parsing |

### Optional Bioconductor Packages

These packages are needed for specific features:

#### For Transcriptome Extraction (Index Creation from Genome)

If you want to create an index from a genome FASTA instead of a transcriptome FASTA:

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(c(
    "Biostrings",
    "rtracklayer",
    "GenomicRanges",
    "IRanges",
    "BSgenome"
))
```

#### For Long-Read Processing (FLNC Pathway)

If you want to process raw FLNC FASTQ files through the minimap2/Bambu pipeline:

```r
BiocManager::install(c(
    "bambu",
    "BiocFileCache",
    "SummarizedExperiment"
))
```

**Note:** If you're using pre-computed Bambu counts (CSV files), you don't need these packages.

---

## System Tool Dependencies

MPAQT uses external bioinformatics tools for read processing.

### Required Tools

These are required for short-read processing:

| Tool | Version | Purpose |
|------|---------|---------|
| **kallisto** | >= 0.50.1 | Short-read pseudoalignment |
| **bustools** | >= 0.43.1 | BUS file processing |

### Optional Tools

These are only needed for specific long-read workflows:

| Tool | Purpose | When Needed |
|------|---------|-------------|
| **minimap2** | Long-read alignment | FLNC FASTQ processing |
| **samtools** | BAM file handling | With minimap2 |

### Installing via Conda (Recommended)

The easiest way to install system tools is using conda:

```bash
# Create a new environment (optional but recommended)
conda create -n mpaqt python=3.10

# Activate the environment
conda activate mpaqt

# Install required tools
conda install -c bioconda kallisto bustools

# Install optional tools (for long-read processing)
conda install -c bioconda minimap2 samtools
```

### Installing via Mamba (Faster)

If you have mamba installed:

```bash
mamba install -c bioconda kallisto bustools minimap2 samtools
```

### Manual Installation

If you prefer not to use conda:

**kallisto**: Download from [pachterlab/kallisto](https://github.com/pachterlab/kallisto/releases)

**bustools**: Download from [BUStools/bustools](https://github.com/BUStools/bustools/releases)

**minimap2**: Download from [lh3/minimap2](https://github.com/lh3/minimap2/releases)

**samtools**: Download from [samtools/samtools](https://github.com/samtools/samtools/releases)

Ensure all tools are available in your `PATH`.

---

## Pre-built Containers and Packages

Instead of installing manually, you can use pre-built containers or conda packages that include MPAQT and all dependencies.

### Available Variants

| Variant | Tag/Package | Description | Use When |
|---------|-------------|-------------|----------|
| **stable** | `2.0.0` / `r-mpaqt` | Core dependencies only (kallisto, bustools) | Standard short-read workflows |
| **full** | `2.0.0-full` / `r-mpaqt-full` | Includes minimap2, samtools, Bioconductor (bambu, Biostrings, etc.) | Long-read FLNC processing, transcriptome extraction |
| **dev** | `2.0.0-dev` / `r-mpaqt-dev` | Includes devtools, testthat, pkgdown | Development and testing |

### Docker

```bash
# Stable (recommended for most users)
docker pull csglab/mpaqt:2.0.0
docker run -it -v $(pwd):/data csglab/mpaqt:2.0.0

# Full (with all optional dependencies)
docker pull csglab/mpaqt:2.0.0-full
docker run -it -v $(pwd):/data csglab/mpaqt:2.0.0-full

# Development
docker pull csglab/mpaqt:2.0.0-dev
```

### Apptainer (for HPC)

First, configure the Sylabs Cloud remote (one-time setup):

```bash
# Add the Sylabs Cloud remote
apptainer remote add --no-login SylabsCloud cloud.sycloud.io

# Set it as default
apptainer remote use SylabsCloud
```

Use `--contain --cleanenv` when running MPAQT images to avoid interference
from host environment variables and home-directory R libraries (for example,
a host `Matrix` package that requires `libflexiblas.so.3`).

With `--contain`, explicitly bind the folder containing your scripts and data.
The examples below use `--bind "$PWD:/work" --pwd /work` to make the current
folder available at `/work` inside the container and run there. Keep analysis
inputs and outputs in that folder, or add `--bind` options for other data folders.

Then pull and run the image:

```bash
# Stable
apptainer pull library://csglab/mpaqt/mpaqt:2.0.0
apptainer exec --contain --cleanenv --bind "$PWD:/work" --pwd /work mpaqt_2.0.0.sif Rscript analysis.R

# Full
apptainer pull library://csglab/mpaqt/mpaqt:2.0.0-full
apptainer exec --contain --cleanenv --bind "$PWD:/work" --pwd /work mpaqt_2.0.0-full.sif Rscript analysis.R

# Development
apptainer pull library://csglab/mpaqt/mpaqt:2.0.0-dev
```

### Conda

```bash
# Stable
conda create -n mpaqt -c csglab r-mpaqt
conda activate mpaqt

# Full (includes minimap2, samtools, Bioconductor packages)
conda create -n mpaqt-full -c csglab r-mpaqt-full

# Development (includes devtools, testthat, etc.)
conda create -n mpaqt-dev -c csglab r-mpaqt-dev
```

### Which Variant Should I Use?

- **stable**: You only need short-read quantification, or you're providing pre-computed long-read counts
- **full**: You need to process raw FLNC FASTQ files, or create indexes from genome FASTA files
- **dev**: You're contributing to MPAQT or running the test suite

## Verifying Installation

### Check R Package

```r
# Load the package
library(mpaqt)

# Check version
packageVersion("mpaqt")
```

### Check System Tools

From R:

```r
library(mpaqt)

# Check kallisto
get_tool_version("kallisto")

# Check bustools
get_tool_version("bustools")

# Check optional tools
get_tool_version("minimap2")
get_tool_version("samtools")
```
From the command line:

```bash
kallisto version
bustools version
minimap2 --version
samtools --version
```

### Test Basic Functionality

```r
# This should work if all required dependencies are installed
library(mpaqt)

# Check that key functions are available
?mpaqt_index
?mpaqt_quant
```

---

## Troubleshooting

### "Package 'X' is not available"

If pak/devtools fails to find a package, try installing it separately:

```r
# For CRAN packages
install.packages("package_name")

# For Bioconductor packages
BiocManager::install("package_name")
```

### "kallisto not found" / "bustools not found"

Ensure the tools are installed and in your PATH:

```bash
# Check if tools are found
which kallisto
which bustools

# If using conda, ensure environment is activated
conda activate mpaqt
```

### Bioconductor Version Conflicts

If you encounter version conflicts with Bioconductor packages:

```r
# Update Bioconductor
BiocManager::install(version = "3.18")  # Use latest stable version

# Then reinstall MPAQT
pak::pak("csglab/MPAQT")
```

### gpboost Installation Issues

gpboost can sometimes be tricky to install. If you encounter issues:

```r
# Try installing from CRAN first
install.packages("gpboost")

# If that fails, you might need system dependencies
# On Ubuntu/Debian:
# sudo apt-get install cmake libboost-all-dev

# On macOS with Homebrew:
# brew install cmake boost
```

### Memory Issues During Installation

If installation runs out of memory:

```r
# Increase the number of connections
options(Ncpus = 1)

# Or install packages one at a time
install.packages("data.table")
install.packages("Matrix")
# etc.
```

## Summary: What You Need

### Minimal Setup (Short-Read Only)

```r
# R packages
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("csglab/MPAQT")
```

Install [kallisto](https://github.com/pachterlab/kallisto) (>= 0.50.1) and [bustools](https://github.com/BUStools/bustools) (>= 0.43.1).

### Full Setup (With Long-Read Processing)

```r
# R packages
pak::pak("csglab/MPAQT")
BiocManager::install(c("Biostrings", "rtracklayer", "bambu", "BSgenome"))
```

Also install [minimap2](https://github.com/lh3/minimap2) and [samtools](https://github.com/samtools/samtools).

---

## Verification Checklist

Run this complete checklist to verify your MPAQT installation:
```r
# 1. Load MPAQT and check version
library(mpaqt)
cat("MPAQT version:", as.character(packageVersion("mpaqt")), "\n")

# 2. Check required system tools
cat("\nRequired tools:\n")
check_kallisto()
check_bustools()

# 3. Check optional tools (only needed for FLNC processing)
cat("\nOptional tools:\n")
tryCatch(check_minimap2(), error = function(e) message("minimap2: not found (optional)"))
tryCatch(check_samtools(), error = function(e) message("samtools: not found (optional)"))

# 4. Check optional Bioconductor packages
cat("\nOptional packages:\n")
cat("Biostrings:", requireNamespace("Biostrings", quietly = TRUE), "\n")
cat("rtracklayer:", requireNamespace("rtracklayer", quietly = TRUE), "\n")
cat("bambu:", requireNamespace("bambu", quietly = TRUE), "\n")
```

**Expected output for minimal setup:**
```
MPAQT version: 0.x.x

Required tools:
✓ kallisto (0.50.1)
✓ bustools (0.43.2)

Optional tools:
minimap2: not found (optional)
samtools: not found (optional)

Optional packages:
Biostrings: FALSE
rtracklayer: FALSE
bambu: FALSE
```
